scope: Pinned source dependency audit only; no classifier execution
tested: Parent/wrapper byte pins matched; AST parsing of six selected sources
findings: Parent classifier requires bound receipt, original spec, result bytes, finish binding, driver status, collected evidence and taxonomy before constructing a forward result. FINISHED alone is insufficient.
Wrapper then requires certificate_check acceptance for cached classes. Existing acceptance handoff and candidate bundle association are required by validate_valid.
Explicit-spec classifier adapter exists but is not selected in observation-only policyV005; future VALID installer must select and test it alongside certificate adapter.

Interface split: observation factory context_for returns Context and sets _external_orch to it; validate_valid expects an Orchestrator with .ctx. Current _validate is disabled. A VALID-capable successor must explicitly separate context and orchestrator rather than merely removing the refusal.
